newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN STOCK EXCHANGE OFFICIAL LIST READY SOON.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN STOCK EXCHANGE OFFICIAL LIST READY SOON.

text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Wednesday it would set up an official list of the bourse's top companies in the next two weeks.
"In the next two weeks we will form the bourse's official list," the director of Lithuania's stock exchange, Rimantas Busila, told Reuters in an interview.

Some 460 companies are currently listed on Lithuania's stock exchange, with 35 on the A list of most actively traded stock. Busila said he was awaiting international audit figures before a final decision would be made about the list.

"It is absolutely clear which companies could be on the official list and the only obstacle which delays the final decision are the international audit results of the financial activity, which are expected soon," Busila said.
"Preliminary conclusions of the audit in all the companies which are candidates for the list are positive," Busila said.
Vilniaus and Hermis banks, packaging company Medienos Plaushas and dairy Rokishkis cheese are the top candidates, Busila said, adding that this group would grow.
"I think that the official list will expand and we expect there will be around ten comapnies on the list before year-end," Busila said. He declined to name other candidates.
In order to make the official list, companies must have been stable and profitable over the last three years, and the company's share capital must be no less than five million litas, Busila said.
A company also must have been listed on the bourse for at least six months and accounting must heed international standards, Busila said.
